title: Director Sales and Key accounts
description:
You already know the maritime industry. You know who makes the decisions, why change takes time and why a trusted relationship matters more than a polished sales pitch.

Source2Sea combines the reach of a global maritime marketplace with the intelligence of a procurement platform. We are looking for a Global Key Account Director to join our Commercial team. Our people are our greatest assets and the driving force behind our mission, which is to enable ‘Shop with Insights. Spend with Confidence’.

We don't just digitalize procurement. We make it smarter. By combining marketplace reach with procurement intelligence, we help shipping companies, ship managers, caterers and suppliers make better purchasing decisions through data-driven insights, recommendations and intelligent procurement tools. We create value beyond the individual transaction, enabling buyers to gain greater visibility and control over spend while helping suppliers grow through digital collaboration.

Source2Sea is part of Wrist Group, the world leader in the field of procuring and delivering supplies to the maritime industry with a turnover in 2024 of more than DKK 5.7 billion.

Reporting to our CEO, you will become part of a strong and exciting commercial team. The position is based in Copenhagen.

Summary

The successful candidate will have excellent door opening skills at highest level in the industry - either through own network, via contacts or by creating an appealing proposition which begins a meaningful communication.

You are motivated by building B2B relationships – challenging customers to rethink how maritime procurement can create greater value through digitalization and data. Through active listening and strong problem solving skills, you are able toprobe and understand the customers pain points and opportunities, and can unlock these in a tangible way.

We expect you to have a “digital-first” mindset and to be the driving force within your area of responsibility; to build long-term partnership while managing day to day relationships.

Your primary responsibilities in this role will be:

Since Source2Sea is in high growth mode the tasks will be broad and varied and a high level of adaption to customer needs is expected. In other words you will be required to roll up your sleeves.

  • The predominant part of the role will be opening doors to shipping companies, listen and understand their business challenges and demonstrate how Source2Sea creates value through our marketplace and procurement platform.

  • Tactical planning and pipeline management to ensure a prioritized approach towards the right customers, based on their individual position, needs and likelihood to embark on the digital journey.

  • Drive customer dialog until commitment to trade on Source2Sea, while gradually looping in the Customer Success team, who will handle the onboarding process and experience.

  • Bring strategic customer insights back into Product, Customer Success and Leadership to help shape the continued development of the Source2Sea platform.

  • Create and maintain sales/account plans for target clients (forecasting, planning, budget management, follow-ups, etc.).

  • Together with the commercial team you will be planning and aligning buyer pipeline category and geographical needs with matching supplier pipeline.

We are looking for these Qualifications & Requirements:

  • A “digital-first” mindset, with the ability to see and sell the benefits of being digital.

  • Door opener and relationship builder, with a documented network with the ability to engage senior executives through a consultative, value-driven sales approach.

  • Minimum 7 years of sales experience at management level.

  • Experience in the maritime industry - from either Shipowner, Ship Manager, Supplier or Service Provider.

  • Active listener with strong problem solving skills.

  • Curiosity – it is not enough to ask "What?”. You want to know “Why?”

  • Ability to travel min. 7 days / month is expected.

In return we offer:

  • A combination of a financially robust enterprise that also offers a scale-up approach.

  • The opportunity to shape the future of maritime procurement.

  • Cutting edge use of technology incl. AI, driving efficiency and a unique customer experience – with a documented strong Net Promotor Score.

  • A modern, agile and forward-looking scale-up without legacy constraints.

  • An international team – currently 7 locations and +10 nationalities.

  • Highly digital and maritime-skilled colleagues to learn from.

  • A combination of working from home and at the office.

  • A professional and challenging job in a global company with an ambitious growth strategy.

  • High impact on own role with great personal development and growth opportunities.

  • The salary and benefits will correspond to your qualifications and results.

Visit www.source2sea.com or our LinkedIn profile to learn more about our great digital scale-up.

About Source2Sea

Source2Sea combines the reach of a global maritime marketplace with the intelligence of a procurement platform. We enable ‘Shop with Insights. Spend with Confidence’ across provisions, stores, spare parts and other vessel supplies through structured digital catalogues, intelligent procurement tools, actionable insights and recommendations.

By connecting shipping companies, ship managers and caterers with a global network of maritime suppliers, Source2Sea creates value beyond the individual transaction. The marketplace provides global supplier reach, greater choice and structured digital catalogues, while the platform transforms the maritime industry's strongest data foundation into greater spend visibility, smarter purchasing decisions, increased automation and more efficient supplier collaboration and growth.

Developed in close collaboration with leading shipping companies and suppliers, Source2Sea already supports global customers at scale and continues to expand its international supplier network and platform capabilities.

Source2Sea is an independent company founded and funded by Wrist Group, the global leader in marine supply and logistics. The venture was established in collaboration with BCG X in 2021 and is headquartered at Woods Augusthus in Copenhagen.

title: Supply Chain Consultant, Central Jutland, Denmark
description:
Six months in Delhi. A career without borders.
Are you ready to take your next career move? This opportunity will take you into the international world of fashion and textile business.Our client is a well-established Scandinavian private label and sourcing company with more than fifteen years of experience serving leading European fashion brands. From its headquarters in Denmark, supported by international sourcing and production teams across Asia and Europe, the business has built a reputation for reliability, long-term partnerships and responsible growth. Today, the company is financially strong, highly respected within the industry and entering an ambitious new phase of international expansion.Having successfully developed a mature sourcing platform in China, the next strategic step is India.

To support that journey, we are looking for an internationally minded Supply Chain Consultant who wants far more than another supply chain position.

A role that starts with an adventure... and becomes a career.
For the first six months, you will be based in Delhi. Not simply visiting suppliers. Not attending occasional meetings. But becoming part of the local organisation, working alongside experienced colleagues and helping establish the processes, collaboration and operational excellence that will support the company's future growth in India.You will experience the business from the inside, build relationships across cultures and gain an understanding of international sourcing that few professionals acquire this early in their careers.When first step og your assignment is complete, you will return to Denmark, continuing in an international position with regular travel between Europe and India, helping connect people, ideas and operations across continents. This is not a temporary assignment. It is the beginning of a long-term international career.

More than supply chain.
You will work with sourcing, production, governance, quality and operational processes. But your real contribution will be something much bigger. You will help transfer proven ways of working into a growing international organisation. You will build relationships between colleagues from different cultures. You will support local teams, develop new ways of working and help ensure that ambitious growth is matched by consistent execution. Success in this role will depend just as much on your ability to earn trust as your ability to optimise processes.

Who are you?
Perhaps you are already working as a Buyer, Merchandiser, Production Coordinator, Supply Chain Specialist or Sourcing Consultant within fashion, textiles or consumer goods.You have developed a solid commercial understanding of production and supply chain and now find yourself looking for something larger than the next promotion. You enjoy responsibility. You are naturally curious. You communicate confidently with people from different cultures. You don't mind leaving your comfort zone if it means accelerating your professional development.And while many people talk about wanting an international career, you are genuinely prepared to live it.Previous experience working with suppliers in India would be highly valued, although your attitude, curiosity and ability to build relationships will be equally important.

Why this opportunity stands out
Few organisations can offer the combination of stability and adventure that this role provides.You will join a profitable, well-established international company with an experienced leadership team, an ambitious growth strategy and a genuine commitment to developing its people.During your assignment in Delhi, accommodation and practical support will be provided, allowing you to focus on the experience itself rather than the logistics. This also means that you will have a driver available, as well as help in the household.More importantly, you will gain something that cannot easily be taught in a classroom or acquired through occasional business travel; international credibility, cross-cultural leadership experience, and the confidence that comes from helping build an organisation across borders.

Interested?
If you are looking for a career that combines international experience, meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to influence how an ambitious organisation grows, we would very much like to hear from you.We make it easy for you, so no written application is necessary. We simply ask you to register with your CV. Your interest will be handled with utmost discretion.

  • A varied and dynamic working day with guests from around the world.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional development through training, coaching, and continuous learning.

If you are passionate about luxury hospitality and take pride in creating unforgettable guest experiences, we would love to hear from you.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application no later than 15 August 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Zeljka Stefanic Urbina at teamlead@hermank.dk. Please include "Portier" in the subject line of your email.

Part of Bühlmann Hotels

Bühlmann Hotels is home to a collection of unique hotels across Denmark, ranging from vibrant city hotels to iconic boutique properties. While each hotel has its own distinctive character, we are united by a shared commitment to exceptional hospitality and the values that define our culture: care, flexibility, presence, passion, and respect for people and the environment.

Learn more about our hotels at www.buhlmann.dk.

title: Professor / Associate Professor in Biomedical Innovation
description:
The Department of Biomedicine at Faculty of Health Sciences at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as Professor / Associate Professor per 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a full-time permanent position.

This initiative is a direct extension of Aarhus University’s Strategy 2030, in which research-based innovation and entrepreneurship are central strategic priorities. To strengthen the university’s capacity to translate research into innovation, the university leadership has established a number of new research and innovation positions across Aarhus University. These positions are intended to foster an innovation mindset throughout the university while generating tangible societal impact through research, innovation, entrepreneurship, and collaboration.

The primary focus for this position is research-based innovation. We are looking for scientists with medical research background who sees opportunities in collaboration with the strong existing research groups at Aarhus University and Aarhus University Hospital and leading international institutions.

About the Department
The Department of Biomedicine provides research-based teaching of the highest quality and is responsible for a large part of the medical degree programme. The department employs approx. 600 people from all over the world, and they make use of the department's modern laboratory, core and animal facilities. The Department of Biomedicine focuses on innovation and entrepreneurship. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your job responsibilities as Professor / Associate Professor
We offer an attractive career opportunity for researchers with a strong track record in medical research and innovation. The successful candidate is expected to:

  • strengthen the department’s research, innovation, and research-based teaching, and contribute to the academic development of Aarhus University and its national and international profile.

  • conduct original, internationally recognized research and demonstrate scientific excellence at the highest international level.

  • have experience with commercialization of research and technology including protection of intellectual property (IP) rights.

  • contribute to the Faculty of Health Sciences’ strategic priorities in innovation and collaboration by supporting the commercialization of research, building innovation capacity, and developing collaborations with external partners.

  • actively engage in Aarhus University’s innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem and contribute to translating research into societal impact through innovation, entrepreneurship, spinouts, and collaborations with industry.

  • contribute to academic citizenship by actively engaging in the department's academic community and fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and respectful working environment.


An attractive start package can be negotiated.

You will report to the Head of Department Thomas G. Jensen.

Your competences as Professor / Associate Professor
You are ready to take co-responsibility for the development of the department's activites and for ensuring that we maintain a good work environment. You naturally involve yourself in interdisciplinary collaboration at departmental, faculty and university level as well as nationally and internationally. As a leader, you inspire others and build strong relationships with students, colleagues and partners.

We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English. International applicants are expected to learn Danish.

In the assessment of the candidates, consideration will be given to:

  • the ability to promote and utilize research results

  • experience with innovation activities

  • the ability to contribute to the development of internal and external cooperation

  • track record in attracting funding

  • visions within the research and innovation area

  • track record for commercialisation of research results, including protection of intellectual property

  • track record for fostering collaboration with industry

  • business development

  • experience and insight to the Danish life science industry

  • patenting, licensing and technology transfers

  • visions within the innovation area


In order to be assessed as qualified for a Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

In order to be assessed as qualified for an Associate Professor position, you must meet these academic criteria.

If you wish to apply for both positions, please submit two separate applications.

Shortlisting will be used.

Questions about the position
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Head of Department Thomas G. Jensen tel.: (+45) 2778 2805.

Your place of work will be the Department of Biomedicine, Høegh-Guldbergs Gade 10, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

We expect to conduct interviews in the beginning of November 2026.

Terms of employment - professor

  • In making the appointment, emphasis will be placed on a high degree of original production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material, hereby documenting that the applicant has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.

  • Moreover, there will be an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime professor is DKK 866.461,38 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed professor supplement and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Professors have the authority to negotiate pay on their own behalf.



Terms of employment – associate professor

  • Appointment as an associate professor requires research and teaching qualifications at the level that can be achieved through the satisfactory completion of a period of appointment as an assistant professor, but may also be obtained in other ways.

  • The applicant is required to have completed a university pedagogical programme or an equivalent programme.

  • The yearly base salary for a fulltime associate professor is DKK 706.233,06 (including a position related supplement, a pre-agreed associate professor supplememt and pension (18.07%)). Additional supplement(s) can be negotiated dependent on experience, special qualifications and performance of special functions. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.



Other terms of employment

  • Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

  • The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).

  • Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.

  • Travel and moving expenses may be covered according to the employee in question and, to a limited extent, the accompanying family.

  • Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.



Application - professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum Vitae

  • Diploma

  • Template for applicant - professor

  • A list of publications

  • A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios

  • The ten publications stated as the most important in the 'Template for applicant - professor' must be submitted

  • Research plan, which is part of the 'Template to applicant - professor' can be uploaded separately (optional)

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)



Application – associate professor
Your application must include the following:

  • Motivated application

  • Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)

  • References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)


We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: Product Quality & Configuration Engineer
description:
Description

We are seeking a driven Product Quality & Compliance Engineer to lead product quality, digital traceability and defence compliance across our R&D, production, and supplier ecosystem.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product development, quality, and compliance. Your focus will be on owning and embedding digital traceability across our R&D and production processes, ensuring quality, consistency, and transparency throughout the product lifecycle, while maintaining and continually improving our ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System (QMS).

You will be Quadsat’s core quality and compliance ambassador both internally and externally, working across R&D, Production, Supply Chain, Commercial, and with our customers to ensure our products meet the highest standards without compromising the agility and innovation that define Quadsat.

A key part of the role will be to build and own the practical configuration management and digital traceability system that connects engineering work, product releases, BOMs, SBOMs, verification evidence, production builds, defects, and delivered product configurations.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for driving quality and compliance across our engineering and production ecosystem. On a day-to-day basis you can expect to:

  • Drive and govern product quality assurance from early concept and design stage through to verification, production, release and lifecycle support.

  • Build, own, and continuously improve Quadsat’s configuration management and digital traceability setup across tools such as Jira, Confluence, PDM, and production records, ensuring that product baselines, releases, BOMs, SBOMs, defects, deviations, and delivered product configurations are controlled and actively used.

  • Own the engineering governance and digital traceability framework in our Jira environment, including workflow and issue structures, traceability, dashboards, release planning and other related processes.

  • Support the R&D Director in managing development activities through Jira, ensuring that processes and requirements are effectively planned, tracked, and integrated into development and release workflows.

  • Coordinate development cycle reviews, compliance reporting, and engineering metrics using Jira data and provide insights to the R&D Director, developers and other stakeholders to enable informed quality-driven decision-making.

  • Coordinate internal and external product testing activities required to demonstrate product performance, quality, and compliance.

  • Lead compliance initiatives to prepare Quadsat's products and engineering processes for future qualification against defence and customer-specific standards, including frameworks such as MIL-STD, STANAG, AQAP, and DO-178, as required by our customers.

  • Maintain and continuously improve Quadsat's ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring effective governance, process maturity, and a culture of continuous improvement.

Skills & Experience

  • Educational background in engineering or technical field.

  • Proven experience working in a quality or compliance role, translating technical standards and compliance requirements into actionable engineering processes and development activities.

  • Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities.

  • Solid understanding of risk management, DFMEA, requirements management, verification, validation, and test coverage methodologies.

  • You are a Jira super user with hands-on experience setting up and maintaining practical engineering governance, configuration management, release management, defect tracking, traceability, and compliance workflows in Jira or similar systems.

  • A pragmatic mindset that balances agility, engineering effectiveness, and defense-grade quality expectations.

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

All candidates must be eligible to obtain security clearance with the Danish Defence and NATO authorities.

Our Dynamic Work Environment

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, pragmatic engineering, and people who want their work to have a lasting impact beyond individual projects.

About Quadsat

Quadsat develops and builds long-range electronic warfare payloads and software that support multi-domain military operations through fast and precise radio frequency detection and geolocation across the electromagnetic spectrum. Our technology enables defense organizations to maintain mission-critical connectivity, ensure resilient communication infrastructures, and achieve operational readiness.

Contact

For recruitment related questions please contact Aislinn Campbell, HR Director, by mail at afc@quadsat.com or by phone at +45 71 74 97 81.

title: Fertility Specialist
description:

International applicants from EU countries are encouraged to apply.

Join one of Denmark’s leading private fertility clinics

Sellmer Fertility Clinic is an established and highly specialised private fertility clinic located in the heart of Aarhus, Denmark. They provide evidence-based fertility treatment in a modern, patient-centred environment, helping individuals and couples realise their dream of becoming parents.

Due to continued growth and an increasing patient demand, they are looking for an experienced Fertility Specialist to join our clinical team.

Whether you are seeking a permanent position or a flexible part-time opportunity alongside your current role, we would like to hear from you.

The Opportunity

This is an exciting opportunity to become part of a highly skilled multidisciplinary team where quality of care, collaboration and professional development are central to everything we do.

Unlike many fertility clinics, our clinical setup allows for an excellent work-life balance:

  • Flexible working arrangements and no work at the weekends.

  • Modern private clinic with highly experienced teams

  • Opportunity to influence clinical development

For candidates with the right experience and ambitions, there may also be the opportunity to develop into a Responsible Physician role in the future.

Your Responsibilities

As a Fertility Specialist, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality fertility care throughout the patient journey, including:

  • Conducting consultations with IVF and IUI patients, including fertility assessments and evaluation of pregnancy potential.

  • Planning and managing ovarian stimulation protocols for IVF and IUI treatment.

  • Performing ultrasound examinations and follicular monitoring.

  • Performing hysterosalpingo-contrast sonography (HyCoSy/HSU).

  • Performing oocyte retrieval procedures.

  • Performing embryo transfer procedures.

  • Performing TESA procedures.

  • Diagnosing and managing fertility-related conditions, including PCOS and endometriosis.

  • Managing treatment-related complications, including infection, bleeding and ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS).

  • Managing egg donation programmes, including donor assessment and evaluation.

  • Managing acute complications related to assisted reproductive treatment.

  • Developing and maintaining clinical treatment protocols and guidelines.

  • Interpreting laboratory results, including blood tests.

  • Performing donor approval and donor work-up in accordance with applicable regulations.

  • Contributing to the training, supervision and professional development of clinical staff.

Your Profile

We are looking for a physician who:

  • Is a licensed medical specialist within Obstetrics & Gynaecology

  • Has experience within reproductive medicine and assisted reproduction

  • Is passionate about delivering outstanding patient care

  • Works independently while contributing positively to a multidisciplinary team

  • Enjoys a collaborative, quality-focused clinical environment

  • Communicates confidently in English

Why Denmark?

Denmark is internationally recognised as one of the world’s leading countries within reproductive medicine and fertility treatment.

Living and working in Denmark offers:

  • Excellent work-life balance

  • High professional standards

  • Modern healthcare system

  • Safe society with a high quality of life

  • International working environment

The clinic also offers help with providing accommodation for the days you’ll be working at the clinic.

Interested?

If you are an experienced Fertility Specialist looking for a rewarding opportunity in one of Scandinavia’s most respected private fertility clinics, we would be delighted to have a conversation with you.

title: Head of Thin Film Processing - DTU Nanolab
description:
DTU Nanolab offers a truly unique opportunity, we are seeking a Head of Thin Film Processing, a position that has not been open for more than 20 years.

At DTU Nanolab we operate at the intersection of academia and industry, creating a unique environment for research, innovation and collaboration. Being Head of Thin Film Processing offers a rare chance to step into a central role within one of Denmark’s most advanced research and technology facilities.

We are looking for an experienced nanofabrication manager who can lead a team of highly experienced process specialists while advancing state-of-the-art technologies and driving the development and optimization of new process flows.

The role demands strong technological insight, solid leadership capabilities, and the ability to navigate a complex and ambitious professional environment. In return, we offer a position with significant influence, where you will help shape the future of nanotechnology.

Job content
As the Head of Thin Film Processing, you will be overall responsible for processes and tools related to plasma etch and deposition of materials. This includes but is not limited to ICP and RIE etchers, PECVD, LPCVD and PVD as well as ALD and relevant in-line characterization equipment (SEM, AFM, XRD, XPS, ellipsometry). You will interact with and advise both academic and industrial users, you will identify needs and participate in the procurement of new equipment and be responsible for processes and material cross-contamination rules related to new and existing tools. In this role, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for a team of highly experienced process specialists, while contributing as an active member of DTU Nanolab’s core management team. We foster a supportive and collaborative working environment with a strong team spirit, and expect you to lead with curiosity, pragmatism, and a solution-oriented mindset.

Furthermore, you will take part in projects that will expand DTU Nanolab’s technological capabilities and expertise in close interaction with research groups and other academic and industrial collaborators. Additionally, you will play a significant part in DTU Nanolab’s ongoing efforts to strengthen collaboration across the Nordic countries and EU, within for example: EuroNanoLab, Nordic Nanolab Network or EU Chips Joint Undertaking efforts.

Qualifications
You must have a Master of Science degree and a Ph.D. degree within a relevant field, such as Micro/Nanofabrication, Physics, Microelectronics, or similar. Industrial experience is a distinct advantage.

We expect you to have:
  • At least 10 years of experience within cleanroom fabrication related to etch and deposition of various materials.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively with both academic and commercial users
  • Broad knowledge of nano-fabrication methods such as lithography (UV, DUV, e-beam), wet chemical etching, dry etching, thin film deposition and process characterization, backend and packaging on a wafer level scale.
  • In depth knowledge of plasma processes for deposition and etching of materials (ICP, RIE, PECVD, LPCVD, PEALD and sputter).
  • In depth knowledge of non-plasma processes (anneal, oxidation, diffusion doping, RTP, ALD, thermal and e-beam PVD).
  • Several years of experience with process development including process yield and process windows.
  • A broad understanding of the micro- and nanofabrication industry and an in depth understanding of its requirements, challenges and timelines.
  • Deep knowledge of common semiconductor materials like silicon, various oxides and metals.
  • Experience and understanding regarding cleanroom, chemical and electrical safety.
  • Proven leadership experience, including responsibility for leading highly skilled technical staff.
  • Fluency in English - both spoken l and written, preferably also Danish but at least an interest and ambition to learn Danish.

Furthermore, it is desirable that you:
  • Are communicative, proactive and curious.
  • Are self-driven and team oriented.
  • Have the ability to inspire and engage others.
  • Have a wholehearted enthusiasm for semiconductor fabrication technology.
  • Have several years of relevant industrial experience.

At DTU Nanolab, safety is a top priority, and we are looking for candidates who can thrive in a highly safety-conscious environment and meet the following physical and mental requirements:
  • Is able to work in an environment where it can be necessary to wear specialized safety and protective equipment.
  • Is able to respond quickly and effectively in emergency situations, including evacuation in case of alarms.
  • Is able to perform tasks that require work while standing up and mobility for longer periods.
  • Is mentally able to handle work with potentially hazardous chemicals and gases in accordance with our mandatory safety procedures.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).

In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The position is a full-time position. Starting as early as possible with respect to mutual agreement.

As Head of Thin Film Processing, you will directly report to the Director of DTU Nanolab.

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus, located approximately 10 km north of Copenhagen.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 20 September 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates.

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Jörg Hübner, Director, jhub@dtu.dk or +45 2278 5157.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Nanolab is a common infrastructure and research facility located at and fully owned by the Technical University of Denmark, DTU. The core facilities consist of a large cleanroom and a state-of-the-art electron microscopy center. The research activities carried out at DTU Nanolab span from nano- and microfabrication with Silicon-based materials, carbon and polymers to the highly sophisticated analysis of nanoscale materials in hard and soft matter.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

title: Senior SCADA Consultant (m/f/d) (Software-Architect)
description:
Do you want to contribute to a secure, reliable construction and operation of renewbale assets for a international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry? PEAK Wind is looking for a Senior SCADA Consultant who can be an integrated part of our SCADA and Cyber Security team, ensuring best-in-class deliverables for our clients, and building a bridge between technical, commercial, and operational OT and SCADA assets.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of renewable energy assets. We take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and Independent Power Producers among our clients.

Solution-driven Senior SCADA Consultant with Technical Network Know-how
Based in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Hamburg, or Zaragoza you will be supporting clients in all aspects of the project lifecycle, from early development to operation.

We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative way of working. SCADA and Cyber Security is a key area for our clients and receives increased attention on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across different disciplines ensuring seamless integration, operation, and Cyber Security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Drafting and reviewing requirements suppliers and service providers of OT systems, SCADA, and Cyber Security for renewable assets, mainly within onshore and offshore wind
- Negotiating SCADA and Cyber Security requirements in various supply and service contracts on behalf of our clients
- Designing basic network archtiecture and identifying functional requirements from network designes
- Supporting operational teams on OT, SCADA, and Cyber Security investigations and improvements
- Identifying and integrating technical upgrades, new systems, and functionalities
- Managing sub-suppliers for performance management, defining maintenance, and optimizing the reliability

Experienced SCADA Consultant with a holistic mindset:
We are looking for a candidate with knowledge within OT/SCADA systems and Cyber Security. You have broad experience working with SCADA, critical OT or IT systems, across the array of different systems used in production environments. Furthermore, you are familiar and used to working with security standards such as ISO270xx, IEC62443, NERC-CIP, or similar. Irrespective of your background, you are solution-oriented and like to find smarter and more efficient ways to solve problems. You are motivated by solving problems and finding solutions that work in the real world and not just on paper. Preferably you have experience in project management or experience from a Supervisor position, which has given you commercial awareness and the ability to work independently. The ideal candidate is self-driven, proactive, and has a solution-oriented attitude. PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. title: Advanced Systems Engineer, Defense Projects, Lystrup
description:
Would you like to play a defining role in shaping next-generation avionics and defense solutions for international aircraft and defense platforms? As our new Advanced Systems Engineer, you will drive and mature complex proposal activities within Air & Land Projects, leveraging your technical expertise within integrated EW suites, advanced aerostructures, and mission-critical technologies. Come and join us in Lystrup!

We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes, as we deliver advanced technologies and mission-critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry. Our systems provide security for people on land, at sea, and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for an Advanced Systems Engineer to become a cornerstone of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose - securing people through advanced technology.

Your role in our team
As our new Advanced Systems Engineer on a specialist level, you will play a key role in driving, structuring, and technically anchoring proposal activities within Air & Land Projects in R&D.

You will enter a highly specialized technical environment with a steep learning curve. Initially, you will work closely with and learn from our Senior Systems Engineer on proposals and our Solution Architect within this technology area, actively supporting them in their ongoing high-value bid processes. Through this close collaboration and mentorship, you will quickly build deep domain knowledge across Terma's Electronic Warfare portfolios. As you mature in the role, you will gradually take full, independent responsibility for driving your own technical proposals from inception to final delivery.

How you will make a meaningful contribution
Your key responsibilities include:
-Technical Bid Execution & Support: Collaborate with Senior Systems Engineers and Solution Architects to build robust technical baselines for international proposals, transforming operational customer needs into mature engineering concepts.
-End-to-End Proposal Drive: Progress from supporting complex bids to independently driving and technically anchoring your own multi-disciplinary proposals across R&D.
-Advanced Hardware & EW Integration: Work across complex boundaries integrating structural components, smart pylons, and pods with safety-critical hardware, Electronic Warfare software, and mechanical interfaces.
-Sensor & Effector Systems: Apply your technical knowledge to integrate cutting-edge sensor technologies (e.g., Radar Warning Receivers, Missile Warning Systems, and Laser Warning Systems) and advanced effector integration (countermeasure dispenser systems / chaff & flare).
-Risk & Estimation Management: Evaluate technical risks, compliance matrices, and engineering estimates to ensure robust, deliverable, and competitive proposals.

Bring your world class expertise into play

You are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement. Moreover, we are also looking for a new colleague with the following qualifications:
-Educational Background: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Electronics, Physics, Systems Engineering, or another highly relevant technical field.
-Industry Experience: Solid, proven experience as a Systems Engineer, Technical Lead, or specialized Bid/Proposal Engineer within the international or European aerospace and defense industry.
-Domain Expertise: Strong knowledge - or a proven capability to quickly master - complex aircraft technologies spanning Electronic Warfare (EW), Self-Protection Systems (SPS), aerostructures, weapon/pylon interfaces, and airborne sensors.
-Platform Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of military aircraft architecture (including fighter jet and helicopter platforms), line-replaceable units (LRUs), and the interplay between hardware (HW), software (SW), and mechanical integration.
-Standards & Frameworks: Familiarity with aerospace/defense standards (e.g., MIL-STD, ARINC, DO-178/DO-254) is a distinct advantage.

As a person, you are technically ambitious, analytical, and possess a strong collaborative mindset. You navigate naturally between deep technical detail and the big-picture system level. You take clear ownership of your tasks, thrive in a high-stakes engineering environment, and possess the communication skills required to align diverse stakeholders and technical experts across an international organization.

We are an international company representing world-class expertise, delivering complex and high-tech products. We value our colleagues and our meaningful contributions to securing people through advanced technology. You will also experience that we have a strong focus on your development, teaching you useful new competences and further strengthening current ones, both professionally and personally. Our company culture is autonomous and engaging, and we acknowledge the importance of flexibility in a great working environment.

When joining Terma, we promise that you will experience: Great people, challenging tasks, world-class expertise, and meaningful contribution in your daily work.

Benefits at Terma

At Terma, we prioritize the well-being of our employees, ensuring they are well taken care of. Joining our team comes with a multitude of perks designed to enhance your social life, cultural experiences, and health.

-International Environment: Explore great teamwork and professional sparring with colleagues around the world.
-Flexible Working Hours: Enjoy the opportunity to work flexibly and the option to work from home up to two days per week. Internet connection at home is paid for by Terma.
-Comprehensive Benefits Package: Receive a 10% paid pension along with a beneficial health care and insurance package. Enjoy discounts from various business partners.
-Well-being Perks: Opportunity to enroll in our on-site massage-offer at our locations in Denmark.
-Social and Professional Events: We have an active staff association that arranges a variety of social activities and events to bring all of our colleagues together.
-Competence networking across professional experts in Terma: Professional presentations and knowledge sharing across the organization.

We are dedicated to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. ur commitment to DEIB (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging) means we actively value and celebrate unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

title: Research Process Scientist in Nanofabrication - DTU Physics
description:
We are looking for a skilled and highly motivated Research Process Scientist specializing in nanofabrication and characterization.

In this role, you will develop advanced nanomechanical and nanophotonic devices with state-of-the-art performance, while taking an active part in the research activities within the Quantum Physics and Information Technology section and the National Center of Excellence for Macroscopic Quantum States, bigQ.

As part of QPIT (Quantum Physics and Information Technology), you will contribute to cutting-edge research in continuous-variable quantum optics, quantum optomechanics, and diamond-based quantum sensing. The position is also on developing new fabrication concepts, advancing device performance, contributing to experimental research, and helping shape future research directions. You will join a vibrant, international team in a collaborative and informal work environment that encourages knowledge sharing and cross-team interaction. You will also have access to state-of-the-art experimental and cleanroom facilities on site.

The job
As a Research Process Scientist, you will work on the design, process development, fabrication, and characterization of various structures and devices, in close collaboration with our PhD students, postdocs, and researchers, with the aim of delivering operational structures of the highest quality. You will also drive your own research and development activities related to nanofabrication processes and device performance. Moreover, you have either a proven track record in nanofabrication, in experimental optomechanics or in experimental diamond physics using novel, high-quality nano- and microstructured devices based on silicon, silica, silicon nitride, and diamond.

You will be expected to contribute scientifically to ongoing and future research projects, including through experimental design, process innovation, data analysis, publications, and research proposals where relevant.

Our expectations of you
We expect the successful candidate to have:
  • a doctoral degree (PhD) in optics/photonics, physics, engineering, or a related field with an equivalent academic level,
  • experience with a range of lithography, etching, and deposition techniques, in particular ICP-RIE, PECVD, LPCVD, and sputtering,
  • experience with electron-beam lithography using standard and non-standard sample sizes,
  • experience in the characterization of micro- and nanostructures, including optical microscopy, atomic force microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy,
  • a strong interest in applying nanofabrication to frontier research in quantum science and technology,
  • the ability to work independently, develop new process strategies, and contribute creatively to research projects, and
  • the ability to maintain an organized and safe work environment.

The candidate should be fluent in English, both written and spoken. Experience with diamond processing and/or developing state-of-the-art mechanical oscillators is an advantage.

What we offer in return
We offer an exciting and impactful position in a dynamic international environment, with a strong emphasis on research, teaching, innovation, and scientific advisory work that benefits society. You will be part of a professional and collaborative culture that values continuous learning, making skills development a core element of our organization. The position provides a high degree of flexibility, supporting a healthy work–life balance.

As one of Europe’s leading research and educational institutions in technical and natural sciences, DTU offers a stimulating setting where you can contribute to cutting-edge advancements and make a meaningful difference.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations.

In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than Monday, 10 August 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates.

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Professor Ulrik Lund Andersen ulrik.andersen@fysik.dtu.dk.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

title: Re-announcement: PhD Positions in Bio-Inspired Flying Robot Design for Powerline Inspection
description:
The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) is reannouncing 2 of 3 PhD positions in the area of digital and embedded electronics, energy harvesting, and bioinspired design for flying robotic technologies. The starting date is as soon as possible and will be agreed with the successful candidates.    

The section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare. 

The section is a vital component of our educational programs in electrical engineering in Odense, offering Bachelor’s and Master of Science degrees in Electronics Engineering.  Over the next few years, the section is expected to expand to include at least 30 academics, including PhD students and engineers, to support research funding, industrial collaboration, and educational activities. This growth will enable the section to continue its contribution to the field of electrical engineering and related areas. 

The SDU campus in Odense comprises five faculties and soon also a large university hospital creating a great concentration of academics and students facilitating interdisciplinary research and rich student life. The city of Odense is culturally rich surrounded by a vibrant and growing robotics community and highly livable with a green banked meandering river cutting through the centre and attractive residential areas. 

 

Job Description

We are seeking highly motivated PhD candidates to join the Carlsberg Accomplish, FreeFly project, an ambitious research project focused on developing a birdlike flying robot for autonomous powerline inspection. Two distinct PhD positions remain available: 

PhD 1 – Energy Harvesting for Bio-Inspired Flying Robots 

You will investigate, analyze, and design novel energy-harvesting techniques that enable soft aerial robots to power their flight using the strong magnetic fields surrounding high-voltage powerlines. Your work will contribute to creating self-sustaining robotic systems capable of infinite flight missions. 

 

PhD 2 – AI-Driven Navigation and Control for Aerial Robots 

You will design and develop advanced navigation, control, and decision-making systems for aerial robots using state-of-the-art AI-methods. This includes exploring spiking neural networks accelerated by FPGA/MPSoC platforms to meet real-time robotics requirements. Your research will advance the autonomous capabilities of our self-recharging inspection drones. 

 

General Responsibilities 

As a PhD student on this project, you will: 

  • Conduct cutting-edge research contributing to the development of a birdlike autonomous flying robot for powerline inspection. 

  • Participate in teaching activities, including course planning and instruction in relevant subject areas. 

  • Collaborate closely with fellow PhD students, postdocs, and other members of the research group in a dynamic, interdisciplinary environment. 

We are looking for detail-oriented, self-driven individuals with a passion for innovation and a commitment to excellence. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply. 

 

Required Qualifications 

  • A completed BSc and MSc degree in electronics, robotics, mechatronics, autonomous systems, or a closely related discipline. Applicants in the final semester of their master’s program are also encouraged to apply. 

  • Strong technical skills in areas such as digital electronics, hardware programming (FPGA/MPSoC), embedded hardware architectures, mechanical design, and wireless energy-harvesting technologies. 

  • Demonstrated ability in academic writing, including preparing scientific reports, documentation, and research publications. 

 

Please indicate in your application which PhD position you are applying for. 

 

For further information about the position, please contact the Head of Digital and High-frequency Electronics Section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid via email.

 

Please submit your application by August 10,2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Assessment and selection process 

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied. Only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Applicants will be informed of their assessment by the faculty. Interviews and tests may be part of the selection process.     

Application

 
Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant’s interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, skills, along with any other relevant information, e.g., teaching experience, computational skills, relevant projects, etc.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). Applicants in the final semester of their master’s program are requested to submit transcripts from all completed semesters. 

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers who can provide an informed reference letter at short notice (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included). 

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5-3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37,075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Start Your International Career as a Gourmet Butcher – Earn a Salary Throughout Your Apprenticeship - Greater Copenhagen, Denmark
description:
Are you a young EU citizen dreaming of a career in food craftsmanship?

This apprenticeship is open to EU citizens who have the right to live and work in Denmark.

At Born & Kolstrup in Rødovre, Denmark, you will receive a paid apprenticeship, an internationally recognised vocational qualification, and the opportunity to become part of one of Denmark's strongest butcher teams. We are proud winners of the Danish Butcher Award 2025 and are looking for a motivated apprentice who wants to develop in a profession built on quality, craftsmanship and teamwork – in a workplace with an informal management style, employee involvement and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

Read more about the award:
https://goderaavarer.dk/aktuelt/nyheder/2025/se-hvem-der-vandt-slagterprisen-2025/

What does a Gourmet Butcher do?

A Danish Gourmet Butcher does not slaughter animals. Instead, the profession focuses on preparing, cutting and refining high-quality meat products and delicacies.

During your apprenticeship, you will learn to:

  • Cut and prepare premium meat products.

  • Produce charcuterie, delicacies, convenience foods and ready meals.

  • Develop new recipes and food products.

  • Work with food safety and quality control.

  • Plan production and work closely with experienced colleagues.

After completing your apprenticeship, you will receive a Danish Journeyman's Certificate, a respected vocational qualification recognised both in Denmark and internationally.

What can you expect from your apprenticeship?

We offer:

  • A paid apprenticeship throughout your education.

  • A thorough introduction and structured training programme.

  • Assistance with finding accommodation, obtaining a CPR number and settling into life in Denmark.

  • A safe workplace with a strong focus on employee well-being.

  • Friendly and experienced colleagues who will support you from day one.

  • An informal working environment with employee involvement.

  • Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.

  • A healthy work-life balance with time for friends and leisure activities.

Several of our employees have worked abroad themselves and understand what it is like to start a new life in another country.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is an EU citizen with the right to live and work in Denmark.

  • Has a passion for food, quality and craftsmanship.

  • Is ambitious and eager to become highly skilled.

  • Has completed compulsory education or an equivalent qualification.

  • Can communicate in English.

  • Is willing to learn Danish and become part of Danish culture.

  • Enjoys teamwork and takes responsibility.

Salary and employment conditions

The apprenticeship lasts 3½ years, and you will receive a salary throughout the entire programme.

Monthly salary (collective agreement between DSM and the Danish Food Workers' Union, NNF):

Apprenticeship Year Salary (DKK) Approx. EUR

1st year per month 13.708 1.835

2nd year per month 17.343 2.321

Remaining apprenticeship per month 20.490 2.743

Adult apprentice per month 26.839 3.593

  • Working hours: 160.33 hours per month

  • Employer-paid pension contribution of 12.6% after three months of employment.

  • Salary is paid in Danish Kroner (DKK).

Your education

Your practical training will take place at Born & Kolstrup, located in Rødovre Centrum, just 8 km from Copenhagen City Hall Square.

The school-based training will take place at ZBC in Roskilde, Denmark's largest vocational college.

title: Electronics Production Technician
description:
Work tasks: The role
As an Electronics Production Technician, you will support the assembly, inspection, testing and rework of electronic components and printed circuit boards used in our products and development systems. You will work closely with our engineering team, following technical documentation and testing procedures, identifying faults and recording results accurately. Your work will help ensure that our electronic assemblies meet the required quality and performance standards. This role is suitable for someone with a vocational background or practical experience in electronics who enjoys precise, hands-on work and wants to develop their skills in an advanced engineering environment. Key responsibilities • Assemble electronic components, printed circuit boards and related systems • Inspect incoming PCB assemblies, components and solder joints visually and under a microscope • Perform soldering, cleaning, handling and rework of PCB assemblies • Carry out electrical measurements and functional testing using standard test equipment and dedicated test rigs • Identify faults, perform initial troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to engineers • Read and follow electronic schematics, datasheets, assembly instructions and testing procedures • Prepare cables, connectors and electronic connections • Record inspection, testing and rework results accurately • Maintain the traceability of components and completed work • Monitor electronic component and consumable inventory and communicate replenishment needs • Provide practical feedback and suggest improvements to assembly, testing and work procedures

We offer: What we offer
• A monthly gross salary of €2394–€3724 depending on your experience and skills • Hands-on work with advanced space and optical communication technology • Close cooperation with electronics, embedded software and mechanical engineers • The opportunity to help establish and improve assembly and testing processes as the company grows • Varied work across electronics assembly, inspection, testing, troubleshooting and production support • A small international team where your contribution has a visible impact on the final product Occasional remote work for suitable tasks may be agreed with the hiring manager. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager.

Other requirements: What we are looking for
Required experience • Vocational education in electronics or equivalent practical experience • Practical experience with electronics assembly and PCB handling • Ability to read electronic schematics, component datasheets and technical instructions • Soldering and PCB rework skills • Ability to use standard electronic test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes and laboratory power supplies • Ability to identify electronic components and understand their markings and package information • Basic fault-finding and troubleshooting skills • A careful, methodical and quality-focused approach • Ability to follow procedures and document work accurately • English at B2 level or above • Willingness to learn new equipment, processes and techniques We welcome applications from both experienced technicians and strong junior candidates with relevant practical skills and a solid foundation in electronics. Nice to have • Experience with surface-mount and through-hole soldering • Experience using hot-air rework equipment • Experience with FBGA rework or reballing • Experience operating pick-and-place or reflow equipment • Experience testing PCB assemblies using dedicated test rigs • Familiarity with IPC workmanship standards or relevant IPC certification • Experience maintaining production, testing or traceability records • Experience with component inventory and production consumables • Previous experience in electronics production, prototyping or a laboratory environment

Option to work from home: No

description:
Work tasks: Key responsibilities
Firmware and embedded software development: - Develop and maintain embedded software and firmware primarily in Rust. - Use C where relevant for embedded and low-level development. - Develop for bare-metal RISC-V and embedded Linux on ARM environments. - Implement reliable software for resource-constrained embedded systems. - Investigate and resolve software, firmware and system-level issues. Hardware integration and verification: - Integrate firmware with electronics, hardware and communication interfaces. - Test, debug and validate software on target hardware. - Support hardware–software integration and system-level testing. - Contribute to verification activities and resolve integration issues. Engineering collaboration and documentation: - Work closely with electronics, optics and systems engineers. - Participate in code reviews and technical discussions. - Create and maintain clear technical documentation. - Help improve software development, testing and documentation practices. - Take increasing ownership of technical tasks as your understanding of our systems develops.

We offer: What we offer:
- A hands-on engineering role with direct impact on advanced optical communication technologies. - Meaningful technical ownership and the opportunity to see your work move from implementation to hardware integration and validation. - Close collaboration with an international and multidisciplinary engineering team. - The opportunity to develop your expertise across embedded software, electronics, optics and aerospace systems. - The ability to contribute to technical decisions and engineering practices as the company grows. - A gross annual base salary of €35,000–€57,000, depending on experience, skills and the expected level of responsibility. - Relocation support to Estonia if required. - Reasonable flexibility in working hours, consistent with operational and team needs. Working arrangement: This is a primarily onsite position in Tallinn, Estonia, as the role involves close collaboration with hardware, integration and testing. Limited hybrid work may be agreed depending on the employee’s responsibilities and the stage of the work. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager. Other important information: This position may require the selected candidate to be eligible to obtain government security clearance. At Golbriak Space, we use our passion for purposeful innovation to help keep people safe and solve complex engineering challenges. We foster an inclusive environment built on integrity, responsibility and employee empowerment.

title: Instruktor/ Veespordijuhendaja (eFoil – elektriline lendav laud) suvehooajaks
description:
Oleme valmis värbama ka alaealisi. Hooajaline töö mere ääres — õpetad inimesi sõitma elektrilise surfiga, nautima elu ja tundma vabadust

Tööülesanded: Mida sa tegelikult teed?
Sa ei istu kontoris. Sa ei vasta e-kirjadele 8 tundi järjest. Hommikul tuled mere äärde. Päike tõuseb Tallinna lahel. Võtad vastu esimesed külalised — mõned erutunud, mõned natuke hirmul. Annad neile 15-20 minutit ohutusinstruktaaži. Selgitad. Naeratad. Tekitad usalduse. Lähed nendega vette või paadiga kõrval. Näed hetke, kui inimene esimest korda lendab üle vee. Nende nägu ütleb kõik. Filmid neid paadilt, kaldalt — sisu, mis läheb viraalseks. Hoolitsed varustuse eest nagu oma asja eest. Laed akud, puhastd tahvlid, hoiad kogu ala korras ja puhtana. Järgmine klient peab nägema täiuslikku — mitte seda, mis järele jäi. Õhtul — loojang mere kohal. Saun. Ice bath.Jacuzzi. Klientide tänulikud sõnad.

Omalt poolt pakume: Mida sa saad vastu?
→ Tasuta eFoil-sõit! Klientidele see maksab 200€ tunnis. Sinu jaoks — tasuta. → Töö maailma ühe coolima spordiga päikesetõusu ja -loojangu ajal → Tulemustasu + boonused → Sinu nägu on meie sotsiaalmeedia — ehitame koos brändi → Võimalus meiega kasvada — Euroopa, maailm on järgmised → Oled osa millestki, mida pole varem olnud — uue turu ehitamine

Muud nõuded: Keda me otsime?
→ Sa oled füüsiliselt aktiivne — see töö nõuab ikka jõudu, vastupidavust ja liikumist → Sa oskad hästi ujuda ja tunneksid end vabalt avatud vees → Suhtled inimestega loomulikult — see on su tugevus, mitte kohustus → Räägid eesti keelt + inglise ja boonuseks - vene keelt → Oled vastutustundlik ja rahulik ka siis, kui kõik ei lähe plaanipäraselt Me otsime inimest, kes näeb mis on vaja — ja teeb ära. Kes kliendi naeratuse nimel läheb sammu kaugemale ilma, et keegi paluks. Kes vee peal teeb kiireid otsuseid ise — rahulikult, kindlalt. Kes võtab vastutuse enda peale — mitte ei otsi, kelle peale näidata. Positiivsus ei ole siin soov. See on nõue. Energiat, initsiatiivi ja täielikku pühendumist — iga päev, mitte ainult headel päevadel. Suur boonus (aga mitte kohustuslik): → Kogemus surfimises, kite, wake, SUP või muus veespordis → Oled filminud videoid või tead, kuidas Instagram/TikTok toimib → Oled varem töötanud instruktori, giidi või teenindajana Pole kunagi eFoil'i sõitnud? Pole probleemi. Õpetame sind.
