title: Retail Activation Specialist 100%  befristet für 12 Monate mit Option auf Festanstellung
description:
Retail Activation Specialist 100% (w/d/m) befristet für 12 Monate mit Option auf Festanstellung  
Du machst unsere Marke durch Events und Aktivierungen sowie starkes In\-Store Storytelling (wie „From Truck To Bag“) auf der Retail\-Fläche erlebbar. Von der Konzeption und Guidance für unsere weltweiten Märkte bis zum Aufbau von Events in der Schweiz: Du verbindest Marketing und Sales, bringst F\-Fans zusammen und begeistert neue Community\-Mitglieder – im F\-Store und im Wholesale.  
Deine Mission  
Du verantwortest den übergreifenden Eventkalender für DTC und Wholesale, schaffst Synergien und stimmst dich dazu eng mit Marketing und Sales ab  
Du konzipierst, planst und setzt Events über den gesamten Store\-Lebenszyklus hinweg um – von Store Openings und Jubiläen bis hin zu Community\-Formaten wie F\-aker Events oder der Aktivierung unserer Services REPAIR, SWAP oder DIY  
Du übernimmst die marketingseitige Projektleitung bei Store\-Eröffnungen, setzt lokale Events in der Schweiz hands\-on um und stellst für internationale Märkte Vorlagen und Guidance bereit  
Du überträgst erfolgreiche Aktivierungskonzepte auf ausgewählte Wholesale\-Partner, um unsere Marke im B2B2C\-Bereich erlebbar zu machen  
Du entwickelst Event\-Toolboxen, Kommunikationsvorlagen und Prozesse in enger Zusammenarbeit mit 3D, Copywriting und Brand Design, um eine effiziente Skalierung zu ermöglichen  
Du nimmst lokale Bedürfnisse aus den Stores auf, übersetzt sie in konkrete Massnahmen, briefst interne Teams für Kommunikationsmaterialien und setzt Storytelling\-Konzepte auf Brand\-Ebene (ausserhalb von Produkt\-Kampagnen, z. B. „From Truck To Bag“) gemeinsam mit Visual Merchandising und Communications um  
Du unterstützt unseren CRM\- und Loyalty\-Manager bei der Umsetzung von Community\-Aktivierungen auf der Retail\-Fläche und evaluierst sowie sicherst die Präsenz unserer F\-Stores in relevanten Design\-, Shopping\- und Tourismus\-Guides (Print \& Online)  
Du packst flexibel bei Special Projects an oder unterstützt andere Rollen im Team bei der Umsetzung ähnlicher Aktivierungs\- und Marketingmassnahmen und stellst bei allen Aktivitäten sicher, dass sie konform mit den FREITAG Werten und unserer Tonalität (Brand Voice) sind

Du besitzt ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder Berufsausbildung im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation oder Eventmanagement  
Du hast 2 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung (Agentur oder In\-House) im Retail Marketing, Event Marketing oder Brand Communication mit Fokus auf Event\- oder Projektmanagement  
Praktische Arbeitserfahrung direkt auf der Retailfläche (im Verkauf) oder im Event\-Bereich ist ein starkes Plus  
Du bringst nachweisbare Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Projektleitung von Events und Aktivierungen mit Retail\-Bezug mit, bist ein Organisationstalent, denkst strukturiert, arbeitest hands\-on, behältst in hektischen Phasen den Überblick und beherrschst gängige Projektmanagement\-Tools sicher  
Du verstehst es, unterschiedliche Interessen zu bündeln, Schnittstellen zu verbinden, Projekte gemeinsam zum Erfolg zu führen, arbeitest mit hohem Mass an Eigenverantwortung, hast Mut zum Ausprobieren und kontinuierlichen Lernen  
Du bist eine positive, energetische und extrovertierte Persönlichkeit, gehst offen auf Menschen zu, steckst andere mit deiner Begeisterung an und identifizierst dich vollkommen mit den FREITAG Werten, die du authentisch nach innen und aussen vertrittst  
Du bist verhandlungssicher in Deutsch und Englisch (Wort und Schrift); weitere Sprachen sind in unserem globalen Setup sehr willkommen

16 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub \& 20 Tage Vaterschaftsurlaub  
Homeoffice \& Remote Work  
Interne und externe Mitarbeiterevents  
F\-Crew Discount und jährlicher WOWcher auf alle FREITAG Produkte, sowie auf unsere NOERD Kantine  
F\-Worker Deals bei verschiedenen Partnerfirmen

title: Internisten (m/w/d) für die umfassende Patientenversorgung in der Schweiz (Facharzt/-ärztin - Innere Medizin)
description:
Für mehrere Regionen in der Schweiz suchen wir zur erweiterten Grundversorgung von Patienten mehrere Internisten und Internistinnen. Die Kliniken, für die wir aktiv suchen, engagieren sich nach neuestem Wissensstand in der Inneren Medizin.
Indem sie sich mit anderen Gesundheitsexperten in der Schweiz vernetzen, ermöglichen sie eine umfassende und hochwirksame Versorgung. Man legt großen Wert auf medizinische Qualität und persönliche Behandlung. Dazu gehört, dass für jede Patientin und Patienten eine individuell abgestimmte Therapie ermöglicht wird. Die Bedürfnisse aller Patientinnen und Patienten stehen stets an erster Stelle.

Unsere starke Partnerschaft mit Kliniken aus dem ganzen Land ermöglicht Ihnen eine hochwertige Arbeitsumgebung und eine schnelle Anstellung.

Für mehrere äußerst interessante Arbeitgeber suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Personen als

Internistin oder Internist für die Patientenversorgung in einem Schweizer Kanton Ihrer Wahl.

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

Die folgenden Punkte variieren je nach Standort ein wenig.

- **Diagnose, Behandlung und Prävention:** Internisten befassen sich mit der Vorbeugung, Diagnose und konservativen (nicht-chirurgischen) Behandlung von Krankheiten der inneren Organe. Dazu gehören unter anderem Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes, Erkrankungen der Atemwege (Lunge), Verdauungserkrankungen, Nierenleiden, hormonelle Störungen, rheumatische Erkrankungen, Infektionskrankheiten und Bluterkrankungen.
- Patientenanamnese und körperliche Untersuchung:
Sie erheben eine detaillierte Krankengeschichte (Anamnese) und führen umfassende körperliche Untersuchungen durch.
- Anordnung und Interpretation von Untersuchungen:
Sie entscheiden, welche Labor-, bildgebenden (z.B. Röntgen, Ultraschall) oder funktionellen Untersuchungen (z.B. EKG, Lungenfunktion) notwendig sind, ordnen diese an und interpretieren die Ergebnisse.
- Erstellung von Behandlungsplänen:
Basierend auf der Diagnose entwickeln sie individuelle Behandlungspläne, verschreiben Medikamente und überwachen den Therapieerfolg.
- Betreuung chronischer Erkrankungen:
Sie sind häufig die erste Anlaufstelle und betreuen Patienten mit chronischen Erkrankungen.
- Beratung zu Krankheitsmanagement und Prävention:
Sie beraten Patienten umfassend zum Umgang mit ihrer Krankheit, zu präventiven Maßnahmen und zur Gesundheitsförderung.
- Koordination der Patientenversorgung:
Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Fachärzten (z.B. Chirurgen, Kardiologen, Rheumatologen) und anderen Gesundheitsberufen zusammen, um eine ganzheitliche und interdisziplinäre Betreuung zu gewährleisten. Sie überweisen Patienten an Spezialärzte, wenn spezielle Behandlungen erforderlich sind.
- Notfallmedizinische Versorgung:
In der Notfallversorgung überwachen und behandeln Sie Patienten mit akut bedrohlichen Zuständen.
- Umfassende Betreuung:
Sie kümmern sich um Patienten aller Altersstufen, wobei besonders in der Praxis ältere und multimorbide Patienten (Patienten mit mehreren chronischen Erkrankungen) häufig sind. Sie sind auch in der Palliativmedizin tätig, um Patienten mit nicht heilbaren Krankheiten zu betreuen.
- Führungsverantwortung, Lehre und Forschung:
Sie übernehmen auch Führungsaufgaben in Kliniken, engagieren sich in der Ausbildung des medizinischen Nachwuchses und sind an wissenschaftlicher Forschung beteiligt.

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

- Facharzttitel für Allgemeine Innere Medizin (AIM) gerne mit Spezialisierung sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen
(EU-Facharzttitel, EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)
- Berufserfahrung mindestens 2 Jahre
- Freude an Teamarbeit, am Teaching von Kolleginnen/Kollegen in Weiterbildung und an konstruktiver, interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Eine offene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit einer patienten-, kunden- und mitarbeiterorientierten Grundhaltung und hohem Engagement
- Erfahrung in einer angiologischen (Kader-)Stellung
Qualifikation für die Durchführung von PTA von Vorteil
- Interesse und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen beim Bewerbungsbeginn nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch beim Stellenantritt. Bei der Einreichung der Unterlagen kann auf unsere Erfahrung zurückgegriffen werden.
- Stilsicheres Deutsch, resp. C1-Zertifikat

Leistungen der Anstellung

- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
- Das Gehalt liegt bei ca. CHF 170.000,- bis CHF 200.000,- brutto pro Jahr bei Vollzeit und bemisst sich je nach Berufserfahrung, Aus- und Weiterbildung
- Vielfältige Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

title: Director of Strategic Communications & PR
description:
Director of Strategic Communications \& PR  
To strengthen its public voice and institutional positioning, the foundation is creating the position of Director of Strategic Communications \& PR, based in Zurich or Bern and a member of the Senior Leadership Team.  
The role. As the foundation's most senior communications leader, you shape and carry its public voice: institutional communications, media relations, political and policy\-related dossiers, and thought leadership on mission\-driven business. You lead a team of three (design and communications), act as the liaison with the foundation's think tank and research activities, and leverage an excellent personal network across Swiss media, institutions and the impact economy ecosystem.  
Key responsibilities  
Define and drive the foundation's overall communications and PR strategy, aligned with its mission and institutional positioning  
Lead institutional communications towards partners, public authorities (Confederation, cantons), academia and the wider ecosystem  
Position the foundation on mission\-driven business topics: purpose\-led companies, sustainable and regenerative economy, corporate responsibility  
Steer political and policy\-related dossiers from a communications perspective: monitoring, messaging, positioning papers, public consultations  
2  
Build and activate a strong network of journalists and editors across German\- and French\-speaking Switzerland  
Act as senior media contact and spokesperson coordination point, in close alignment with the CEO  
Prepare and place op\-eds, interviews, keynotes and public interventions for the CEO and leadership team  
Manage issues and reputation: anticipate sensitive topics, prepare positions, coordinate responses  
3  
Serve as the communications interface with the foundation's think tank and research activities  
Translate research findings, barometers and studies into compelling public narratives, publications and campaigns  
Orchestrate flagship publication launches and public events with the research and programme teams  
Ensure consistency of messaging between research outputs, institutional positions and programme communications  
4  
Lead, develop and inspire a team of 3 (designer and communications professionals)  
Oversee all channels: website, newsletters, social media, publications and brand consistency  
Manage the communications budget, agencies and external providers (PR, content, translation)  
Define KPIs and report regularly on communications performance to the Senior Leadership Team and the Board  
Your profile  
Essential qualifications  
Senior communications experience — minimum 8 years in strategic communications, PR or public affairs, including at least 3 years in a leadership role with team responsibility (foundation, NGO, international organisation, think tank, corporate affairs or agency at director level)  
Excellent network — established personal relationships with Swiss media, federal and cantonal institutions, and the sustainability/impact ecosystem  
Political and institutional literacy — proven experience handling policy\-related dossiers, public affairs or political communications in the Swiss context  
Trilingual fluency — DE and EN fluent (working languages for media and institutions), FR fluent (Suisse romande community and partners)  
Outstanding writing and storytelling — ability to craft institutional messaging, op\-eds and public narratives at native\-level quality in German, and confidently in English and French  
Leadership — experience managing and developing a small multidisciplinary team (content, design)  
Highly valued  
Knowledge of the Swiss philanthropy and foundation ecosystem, and of the B Corp / mission\-driven business movement  
Experience working with or within a think tank, research institution or evidence\-based advocacy organisation  
Experience in organisational transitions (rebranding, repositioning, mergers)  
Familiarity with digital communications analytics and modern content operations (CRM, marketing automation, AI\-assisted workflows)  
Personal qualities  
Strategic mind, hands\-on attitude — comfortable moving between Senior Leadership Team discussions and drafting a press release  
Credibility and presence — a trusted counterpart for editors\-in\-chief, senior officials and board members  
Sound political judgement — non\-partisan, balanced and rigorous on sensitive public topics  
Calm under pressure — composed handling of media dynamics and sensitive dossiers  
Genuine commitment to the foundation's mission — communications as a lever for a sustainable and regenerative economy  
Conditions  
Compensation — according to seniority and experience  
Contract — permanent, full time or 80 % depending on the candidate's preference  
Location — Zurich or Bern, majority on\-site with hybrid flexibility (1 day/week); regular travel across Switzerland  
Start date — as soon as possible  
Governance — member of the Senior Leadership Team, reporting directly to the CEO  
Equipment and development — laptop, digital tools and an annual professional development budget  
Benefits — 25 days of annual leave, partial remote work, mission\-driven environment  
Why this role  
A rare opportunity to shape the public voice of a leading Swiss mission\-driven foundation at a pivotal moment of its development — with a seat at the leadership table, a talented team, and direct influence on how mission\-driven business and policy topics are debated in Switzerland.  
Your application should include:  
CV (. 2 pages)  
Cover letter focusing on:  
a communications or PR strategy you designed and led, and its measurable impact;  
a sensitive political, institutional or media dossier you managed (context, role, outcome);  
your motivation for putting your network and expertise at the service of the foundation's mission.  
Availability (starting date, envisaged workload)  
1–3 professional references  
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and treated in strict confidence.  
Selection process  
Pre\-qualification — 30\-minute call  
In\-depth interview — 60 min (track record, key experiences, fit) with the CEO and a member of the Senior Leadership Team  
Practical case study — 60 min, based on provided materials (scenario: positioning the foundation on a sensitive policy topic, incl. media Q\&A)  
Final conversation — with the CEO and a representative of the Board of the foundation  
Indicative timeline for the full process: 2\-3 weeks from receipt of the application. jpid17ca4a5jm jit0831jm jiy26jm

title: Solution Engineer/ Expert 80-100%
description:
Solution Engineer/ Expert 80\-100%  
Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our long\-term client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a  
Solution Engineer/ Expert 80\-100%  
Background:  
The Opportunity: Build the Foundation for Life\-Saving Technology!  
Are you driven by a deep need to understand how systems work, from the kernel to the application layer? Do you see a working system not as an endpoint, but as a baseline for improvement, optimization, and hardening?  
We are a specialized team of software and hardware experts at the heart of Roche's medical instrument development. We build and own "Roche Linux", a purpose\-built, Debian\-based platform that powers the next generation of medical devices. We are seeking a senior engineer to join our team, someone who combines deep technical mastery with a passion for craftsmanship and a relentless drive to make things better.  
In this role, you will be a core contributor and consultant, ensuring the foundational operating system is robust, secure, and perfectly tailored to the demanding world of MedTech.  
Tasks \& Responsibilities:  
Architect and Engineer our Core OS Platform: Take ownership of our custom Debian\-based distribution. This includes everything from kernel customization and driver integration to the creation, maintenance, and optimization of Debian packages.  
Master the Build and Release Pipeline: Evolve and improve the infrastructure and processes used to build, test, and release our Linux distribution, ensuring reliability and reproducibility.  
Be the Ultimate Escalation Point: Act as the go\-to expert for complex, low\-level system issues. Perform deep\-dive troubleshooting, debugging, and root\-cause analysis across both software and hardware.  
Consult and Empower Development Teams: Guide internal project teams on how to best leverage the Roche Linux platform.  
Proactively Drive Improvement: Constantly seek out opportunities to enhance our distribution, tools, and processes. Whether it's improving system performance, strengthening security, or automating a complex workflow, you will be expected to identify needs and champion solutions.  
Must Haves:  
Deep, Hands\-On Linux Mastery (10\+ years): You are a seasoned professional who is comfortable across the entire Linux stack.  
Custom Distribution Engineering: Proven, extensive experience building, modifying, or maintaining a customized Linux distribution, with a strong preference for Debian (e.g.,using tools like debootstrap, molior, aptly).  
Expertise in Debian Packaging: You don't just apt\-get install. You can create, patch, and maintain .deb packages from scratch, understanding policy, dependencies and best practices.  
Strong Scripting and Automation Skills: Fluency in and Shell scripting is essential for building tools and automating system tasks.  
Fundamental Systems Knowledge: A solid grasp of operating system theory (process management, memory, filesystems), software build systems (make, CMake), and the full testing and packaging lifecycle.  
Advanced English is mandatory; German is a welcome bonus.  
Nice to Have:  
Proficiency in a systems programming language like C or C\+\+.  
Experience with embedded systems, the ARM platform, hardware drivers, and low\-level hardware/software integration.  
Knowledge of modern infrastructure: Virtualization (KVM), Containers (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).  
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS).  
What you will be offered:  
An opportunity to work in one of the world's most important pharmaceutical companies  
Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting areas  
Central location in Basel  
Varied job profile  
Further training opportunities through temptraining  
Working in a dynamic and motivated team  
If you are interested please send your application documents addressed to Ms Buser.  
Linux Platform Engineering Debian Shell Scripting CMake Build Systems Docker Kubernetes KVM C\+\+ AWS Automation jpid4934737jm jit0831jm jiy26jm

title: Human Factors Engineer
description:
Human Factors Engineer  
Roche Schweiz bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our longstanding client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a  
Human Factors Engineer  
Background:  
Roche Diagnostics Global Customer Experience and Solution Design Team (CXSD team) is looking for a passionate Senior Human Factors Engineer to redefine Roche User Interface and Product design and transform the Healthcare industry for the better. At CXSD you will join an international group of designers that serve our purpose to bring the voice of customers to the core of Roche Diagnostics decisions by designing and enabling a seamless patient\-centric experience across our portfolio of products and services. You’ll be part of building design maturity for Roche with peers who are passionate, energetic, and caring in a connected, multicultural, highly motivated team.  
As a Human Factors Engineer, you will play a key role in the development of the next generation of medical devices that can diagnose critical diseases. You will be responsible for leading and documenting studies aimed at providing insights for the development team to improve the design as well as to provide objective evidence that the design outputs of a certain phase in the product development life\-cycle are meeting all requirements.  
The Perfect Candidate has more than 5 years of experience in applied Human Factor Engineering and in Design Control Management. Additionally, the person is experienced in the Usability Engineering process for medical devices made of both hardware and software, as well as in planning, executing, and documenting usability studies in the medical field. Also, the person is knowledgeable of the IEC 62366 standard and the latest FDA guidance on applying human factors engineering. Lastly, the candidate communicates fluently in English.  
Tasks \& Responsibilities:  
Be the voice of patients and Roche users in every product\-related discussion  
Identify user profiles, tasks, hazard\-related use scenarios, usability risks, and requirements  
Responsible for translating UX research insights, user needs, business requirements, and technical requirements into pleasant and efficient User Experiences  
Responsible for creating medical device usability deliverables according to IEC 62366  
Create and facilitate workshops with the product teams to gather system\-level information and to coordinate the design deliverables  
Plan formative and summative usability studies and coordinate external suppliers in the process  
Prepare, maintain, and review Usability Engineering Files  
Advocate for accessibility, quality, and usability for end\-users at Roche Diagnostics  
Provide guidance and mentorship to more junior designers supporting them on professional development, output, and productivity  
Must Haves:  
Master's degree in Science, Industrial Engineering, Human Factors Engineering, or other related technical field  
Min. 5 years experience in applied Human Factor Engineering and in Design Control Management  
Experience in the Usability Engineering process for medical devices made of both hardware and software  
Experienced in planning, executing, and documenting usability studies in the medical field  
Experience collecting and analyzing physiological and behavioral data  
Experience in creating, facilitating, and analyzing workshops with customers and stakeholders  
Excellent presentation skills and ability to communicate know\-how, experiences, ideas, solutions, and deliverables effectively and persuasively  
Knowledge of the IEC 62366 standard and the latest FDA guidance on applying human factors engineering  
Fluency in English. Other languages are always a big plus  
What is offered:  
A chance to contribute to one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies  
Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting zones  
Central location with motorway connection and train station nearby  
Varied work profile  
Home office possibility  
Training opportunities through temptraining  
Collaboration in a dynamic and motivated team  
Good remuneration  
You are welcome to send your complete application documents to Mr. Räfle.

title: Responsable d’hébergements de location
description:
Responsable d’hébergements de location  
L’Entreprise  
Mrs Miggins est un acteur majeur de la location de biens immobiliers de luxe dans les Alpes suisses. Présent dans les stations les plus prisées du Valais (Crans\-Montana, Grimentz, Champéry), l'entreprise cultive depuis plus de 20 ans un art de vivre suisse raffiné. Nous sélectionnons rigoureusement nos propriétés pour garantir à nos hôtes une expérience inoubliable, où chaque détail est orchestré avec excellence.  
Le Poste  
Situé à 1600 mètres d’altitude, le Chalet Les Rahâs à Grimentz est un appart\-hôtel d'exception. Bénéficiant d'un emplacement stratégique à 5 minutes à pied des remontées mécaniques, il allie une architecture contemporaine aux codes du chalet traditionnel et propose une quarantaine d'appartements de standing répartis sur plusieurs bâtiments.  
Nous recherchons un(e) Responsable d’hébergement pour renforcer notre équipe sur site.  
Missions Principales  
Rattaché(e) à la direction, vous assurez la gestion opérationnelle, l'accueil de la clientèle et le pilotage des activités quotidiennes de l'établissement. Vos responsabilités s'articulent autour de trois axes :  
Accueil et Expérience Client  
Gestion complète du cycle de séjour : check\-in et check\-out, avec une attention particulière au service personnalisé.  
Contrôle qualité rigoureux des appartements avant arrivée et après départ.  
Émission et suivi de la facturation client.  
Gestion Opérationnelle et Administrative  
Équipes : Organisation, supervision et coordination des équipes de ménage et de maintenance.  
Stocks \& Inventaires : Gestion des approvisionnements, suivi des stocks et contrôle régulier des inventaires.  
Propriétés : Suivi des travaux de rénovation, de réparation et de remplacement ; gestion opérationnelle des relations avec les propriétaires.  
Développement et Amélioration Continue  
Prospection et acquisition de nouvelles propriétés pour étendre le portefeuille.  
Conception et mise en place de procédures opérationnelles pour optimiser l'efficacité de l'exploitation.  
Profil Requis  
Formation : Bachelor ou diplôme d'école de gestion/hôtelière (ou équivalent).  
Expérience : Minimum 2 ans d'expérience dans un poste similaire (accueil, gestion immobilière ou hôtellerie de luxe).  
Compétences techniques : Maîtrise des outils informatiques (MS Office) et de logiciels CRM. Une connaissance basique des systèmes PMS est un plus.  
Langues : Français et anglais (niveau C1, écrit et parlé). L'allemand est un atout majeur ; une autre langue est un plus.  
Qualités humaines : organisation, rigueur, autonomie et flexibilité. Vous faites preuve d'une excellente présentation, d'un sens aigu du relationnel et de diplomatie. Votre proactivité, votre capacité d'adaptation et votre résistance au stress sont essentielles pour évoluer dans un environnement dynamique.  
Situation géographique : Afin de garantir une excellente réactivité et qualité de service, nous privilégions les candidatures de profils basés à proximité de Grimentz (moins de 40 minutes de trajet)  
Conditions du Poste  
Contrat : CDI à 80 %.  
Début : 1er novembre 2026  
Mobilité : Permis de conduire obligatoire. Véhicule de fonction mis à disposition pour les trajets professionnels.  
Éligibilité : Ouvert aux citoyens suisses, détenteurs d'un passeport européen ou d'un permis de travail suisse valide.  
Ce que nous offrons  
Un environnement de travail stimulant au cœur des Alpes, l'opportunité de travailler sur des biens de luxe et des conditions d'emploi attractives.  
Candidature  
Les candidats dont le profil correspond aux exigences seront recontactés. Veuillez transmettre votre dossier complet (CV, lettre de motivation, certificats de travail et prétentions salariales) à l'attention de Mathilda Colelough. jpid0e95db2jm jpit0831jm jpiy26jm

title: Equipment Management Database Specialist
description:
What you'll do
The role is responsible for ensuring that all equipment installed or removed during CMS Long Shutdown 3 (LS3) is accurately recorded in the CMS Equipment Management Database (EMdb). Acting as the interface between the physical inventory and the database, the post-holder ensures data consistency, maintains and enhances the database and its associated applications, and develops tools to improve data visualisation and accessibility.  The role combines strong IT expertise with an understanding of the CMS experiment's equipment and asset management processes. It also provides support to colleagues across the CMS experiment in keeping the database up to date by preparing dedicated documentation and labelling for the services installation campaign, ensuring that equipment can be accurately identified, tracked and managed throughout its lifecycle.

Your responsibilities
Ensure the consistency, accuracy and integrity of the CMS Equipment Management Database by synchronising it with the physical installation and decommissioning of equipment.
Act as the interface between field inventory activities of CMS teams and the Equipment Management Database, ensuring that all equipment installations, removals and modifications are accurately reflected in the system.
Maintain, support and enhance the Equipment Management Database and its applications, ensuring their reliability and long-term sustainability while developing new features, dashboards and visualisation tools for equipment traceability, data quality monitoring and reporting.
Drive continuous improvements to the usability, functionality and efficiency of the Equipment Management Database by streamlining the registration and management of equipment, cables and other assets, and enhancing data management and asset traceability across the CMS experiment.
Supporting work on the field, to ensure that the operational aspects of asset installation run smoothly for the CMS experiment and that there is coherence between installed equipment and services and the database inventory
Collaborate with the CERN Enterprise Asset Management service and ensure the inter-operationality of processes within the CERN-wide infrastructure and applications.

Your profile
Experience with relational databases and SQL.
Experience with web application development, using for example Oracle APEX, PHP, JavaScript, client-oriented APIs.
Experience monitoring data quality and ensuring data consistency between physical assets and the digital inventory system.
Experience with engineering equipment, scientific infrastructure, or large-scale technical installations.
Ability to develop dashboards and application features.
Proactive in improving processes and application functionality.
Familiarity with the CMS Experimental and upgrade program is an advantage.
Ability to bridge operational activities in the field with IT systems and interface CERN asset management procedures.
Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computer Science or Applied Physics or a related field.

Your skills
Knowledge of database and/or data mining architectures and technologies.
Conceptualising, designing and developing user experiences and interfaces.
Decommissioning and disposal of detector components and systems.
Development of application software.
Defines clear objectives, milestones and deliverables before initiating work/ project.
Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships.
Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
Addresses complex problems by breaking them down into manageable components.
Proposes ways to improve or streamline existing procedures, processes and methodologies.
Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
Medical hazard
Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

Employment conditions
A valid driving licence.
Interventions in underground installations.
Work in Radiation Areas.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria
You are a national of a CERN Member State or Associate Member State. Currently, we cannot consider applications from Pakistani, Lithuanian, Latvian, Cypriot and Croatian nationals, as the ceiling defined under Article II.5 of the Associate Membership Agreement has been reached.
You have relevant qualifications and professional experience.
If you have previously held a Staff contract at CERN, you will not be eligible for these positions.
Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.

title: Installed Base Manager 40 - 50% (f/m/d)
description:
The opportunity
Are you analytical, structured, and energized by turning complex data into real business impact? Do you want a role with global reach where the data you own becomes a direct lever for Sales, Service, and business growth? Then we have the ideal opportunity for you!
As Installed Base Manager at our Product Service Centre in Zurich, you will take ownership of the worldwide installed base for the high voltage products manufactured at our Swiss factories. Based in our Product Management and Marketing team, you will collaborate closely with Country Installed Base Managers around the globe, safeguard the accuracy of service history and asset data, and empower Sales, Service, and technical functions with dashboards and analyses that drive business decisions.


How you'll make an impact
•    Safeguard the data quality of the global installed base for our Swiss-manufactured high voltage products
•    Build strong working relationships with our Country Installed Base Managers worldwide, act as their central product counterpart, and jointly identify bottlenecks, opportunities, and priorities
•    Prepare, analyze, and enrich large data sets, identify errors, and continuously improve data quality
•    Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and tailored analyses that empower Service Sales, Area Sales Managers, and technical troubleshooting teams
•    Deliver cross-functional digital analyses and dashboards that create value beyond the installed base scope
•    Ensure a smooth data handover from new business to service in close collaboration with the Quality department, and partner with Field Service Management to keep field data accurate


Your background
•    Bachelor's or master's degree in industrial engineering, business informatics, data science, or a related field; open to both recent graduates and candidates with some years of relevant experience
•    Strong analytical mindset and a passion for data quality, with structured and reproducible ways of working
•    Experience with Power BI, or a clear motivation to build up these skills; SAP knowledge is beneficial and SQL is a plus
•    Curiosity and a problem-solver's mindset: you enjoy digging into complex topics and designing pragmatic solutions
•    A balance of vision and adaptability, with comfort in guiding stakeholders through change
•    Strong collaboration and communication skills across functions and regions
•    Fluent English is mandatory; German and any other language are considered an asset


More about us
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

title: Equipment Management Database Specialist
description:
What you'll do
The role is responsible for ensuring that all equipment installed or removed during CMS Long Shutdown 3 (LS3) is accurately recorded in the CMS Equipment Management Database (EMdb). Acting as the interface between the physical inventory and the database, the post-holder ensures data consistency, maintains and enhances the database and its associated applications, and develops tools to improve data visualisation and accessibility.  The role combines strong IT expertise with an understanding of the CMS experiment's equipment and asset management processes. It also provides support to colleagues across the CMS experiment in keeping the database up to date by preparing dedicated documentation and labelling for the services installation campaign, ensuring that equipment can be accurately identified, tracked and managed throughout its lifecycle.

Your responsibilities
Ensure the consistency, accuracy and integrity of the CMS Equipment Management Database by synchronising it with the physical installation and decommissioning of equipment.
Act as the interface between field inventory activities of CMS teams and the Equipment Management Database, ensuring that all equipment installations, removals and modifications are accurately reflected in the system.
Maintain, support and enhance the Equipment Management Database and its applications, ensuring their reliability and long-term sustainability while developing new features, dashboards and visualisation tools for equipment traceability, data quality monitoring and reporting.
Drive continuous improvements to the usability, functionality and efficiency of the Equipment Management Database by streamlining the registration and management of equipment, cables and other assets, and enhancing data management and asset traceability across the CMS experiment.
Supporting work on the field, to ensure that the operational aspects of asset installation run smoothly for the CMS experiment and that there is coherence between installed equipment and services and the database inventory
Collaborate with the CERN Enterprise Asset Management service and ensure the inter-operationality of processes within the CERN-wide infrastructure and applications.

Your profile
Experience with relational databases and SQL.
Experience with web application development, using for example Oracle APEX, PHP, JavaScript, client-oriented APIs.
Experience monitoring data quality and ensuring data consistency between physical assets and the digital inventory system.
Experience with engineering equipment, scientific infrastructure, or large-scale technical installations.
Ability to develop dashboards and application features.
Proactive in improving processes and application functionality.
Familiarity with the CMS Experimental and upgrade program is an advantage.
Ability to bridge operational activities in the field with IT systems and interface CERN asset management procedures.
Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computer Science or Applied Physics or a related field.

Your skills
Knowledge of database and/or data mining architectures and technologies.
Conceptualising, designing and developing user experiences and interfaces.
Decommissioning and disposal of detector components and systems.
Development of application software.
Defines clear objectives, milestones and deliverables before initiating work/ project.
Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships.
Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
Addresses complex problems by breaking them down into manageable components.
Proposes ways to improve or streamline existing procedures, processes and methodologies.
Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
Medical hazard
Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

Employment conditions
A valid driving licence.
Interventions in underground installations.
Work in Radiation Areas.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria
You are a national of a CERN Member State or Associate Member State. Currently, we cannot consider applications from Pakistani, Lithuanian, Latvian, Cypriot and Croatian nationals, as the ceiling defined under Article II.5 of the Associate Membership Agreement has been reached.
You have relevant qualifications and professional experience.
If you have previously held a Staff contract at CERN, you will not be eligible for these positions.
Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.

Key responsibilities  
Define and drive the foundation's overall communications and PR strategy, aligned with its mission and institutional positioning  
Lead institutional communications towards partners, public authorities (Confederation, cantons), academia and the wider ecosystem  
Position the foundation on mission\-driven business topics: purpose\-led companies, sustainable and regenerative economy, corporate responsibility  
Steer political and policy\-related dossiers from a communications perspective: monitoring, messaging, positioning papers, public consultations  
2  
Build and activate a strong network of journalists and editors across German\- and French\-speaking Switzerland  
Act as senior media contact and spokesperson coordination point, in close alignment with the CEO  
Prepare and place op\-eds, interviews, keynotes and public interventions for the CEO and leadership team  
Manage issues and reputation: anticipate sensitive topics, prepare positions, coordinate responses  
3  
Serve as the communications interface with the foundation's think tank and research activities  
Translate research findings, barometers and studies into compelling public narratives, publications and campaigns  
Orchestrate flagship publication launches and public events with the research and programme teams  
Ensure consistency of messaging between research outputs, institutional positions and programme communications  
4  
Lead, develop and inspire a team of 3 (designer and communications professionals)  
Oversee all channels: website, newsletters, social media, publications and brand consistency  
Manage the communications budget, agencies and external providers (PR, content, translation)  
Define KPIs and report regularly on communications performance to the Senior Leadership Team and the Board  
Your profile  
Essential qualifications  
Senior communications experience — minimum 8 years in strategic communications, PR or public affairs, including at least 3 years in a leadership role with team responsibility (foundation, NGO, international organisation, think tank, corporate affairs or agency at director level)  
Excellent network — established personal relationships with Swiss media, federal and cantonal institutions, and the sustainability/impact ecosystem  
Political and institutional literacy — proven experience handling policy\-related dossiers, public affairs or political communications in the Swiss context  
Trilingual fluency — DE and EN fluent (working languages for media and institutions), FR fluent (Suisse romande community and partners)  
Outstanding writing and storytelling — ability to craft institutional messaging, op\-eds and public narratives at native\-level quality in German, and confidently in English and French  
Leadership — experience managing and developing a small multidisciplinary team (content, design)  
Highly valued  
Knowledge of the Swiss philanthropy and foundation ecosystem, and of the B Corp / mission\-driven business movement  
Experience working with or within a think tank, research institution or evidence\-based advocacy organisation  
Experience in organisational transitions (rebranding, repositioning, mergers)

Credibility and presence — a trusted counterpart for editors\-in\-chief, senior officials and board members  
Sound political judgement — non\-partisan, balanced and rigorous on sensitive public topics  
Calm under pressure — composed handling of media dynamics and sensitive dossiers  
Genuine commitment to the foundation's mission — communications as a lever for a sustainable and regenerative economy  
Conditions  
Compensation — according to seniority and experience  
Contract — permanent, full time or 80 % depending on the candidate's preference

Start date — as soon as possible  
Governance — member of the Senior Leadership Team, reporting directly to the CEO  
Equipment and development — laptop, digital tools and an annual professional development budget  
Benefits — 25 days of annual leave, partial remote work, mission\-driven environment

A rare opportunity to shape the public voice of a leading Swiss mission\-driven foundation at a pivotal moment of its development — with a seat at the leadership table, a talented team, and direct influence on how mission\-driven business and policy topics are debated in Switzerland.

title: Legal Counsel / Contracts Specialist for ETH Zurich | Space
description:
ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities in the fields of science and engineering. Through its strategic initiative, ETH Zurich │ Space is systematically expanding its activities in space research and technology. A unique environment for innovation is being created through the recruitment of high-calibre researchers of international standing and the expansion of collaborations with leading partners from academia, space agencies and industry.

Within the Vice-Presidency for Knowledge Transfer and Corporate Relations, the Research Contracts Group supports researchers in ensuring that their projects with national and international partners are built on a solid legal foundation.

To strengthen our team, we are seeking, with immediate effect or by agreement, a committed, solution-oriented and strong negotiator to take on the role of Legal Counsel for ETH Zurich │ Space.
Job description

Your role at the interface between space research and law

In this role, you will be the key legal point of contact for the research activities of ETH Zurich │ Space and ETH Swiss GeoLab. You will be part of a strong team of around 20 legal professionals in the Research Contracts Group, where you will benefit from their broad expertise and mutual exchange of ideas. Your personal focus will be on independently managing the space-related portfolio. Against the backdrop of a steadily growing number of collaborations, you will facilitate and promote the conclusion of contracts between ETH researchers and space-related organisations – ranging from industrial companies and start-ups to international space agencies, as well as academic and public institutions. You will advise researchers and management on the drafting and negotiation of complex research contracts and help to ensure that innovative research projects are implemented in a legally sound and efficient manner. This encompasses both traditional space technologies (e.g. hardware) and Earth observation, the processing of geo-information and the use of space data on Earth. In doing so, you also act as a bridge to Swiss stakeholders in government bodies and the business sector.

You will support scientists with their projects from the initial idea for collaboration right through to the conclusion of a contract and lay the legal foundations for world-class international research in a highly dynamic environment.

Your key responsibilities

- You will independently review, draft and negotiate complex national and international research and development contracts, in particular Research Collaboration Agreements, Consortium Agreements, Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) and other research and cooperation agreements.
- You will manage projects with international space agencies, research institutions and industry partners, particularly within the context of the European Space Agency (ESA), NASA, the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) and other international space and research partners.
- You will advise researchers and project managers on legal issues relating to international research collaborations, intellectual property, liability matters and other contractual risks.
- You will provide support on matters relating to export controls and dual-use goods, working closely with the relevant compliance units at ETH Zurich.
- You will provide proactive and solution-oriented advice to researchers and project managers throughout the entire project lifecycle – from project initiation to successful completion.
- You will further develop contract templates, guidelines and standard processes for the efficient and legally compliant management of space and research projects.
- You will work closely with ETH transfer, compliance units and other internal and external stakeholders.

This position is centered on mass spectrometry data, with a primary focus on bioinformatics analysis and interpretation in support of researchers at the FGCZ. The unit maintains a portfolio of commercial and open-source applications operating on our infrastructure and establishes novel data processing and analysis pipelines.  An integral part of the work is integrating the data into our data management system and ensuring the reproducibility of the analysis.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Windows and Linux operating systems, including command-line interfaces
- Practical knowledge of at least one programming language (C++, C#, Java, Python) and tools such as Git

- Familiarity with the management and analysis of large-scale datasets, in particular omics-related data

- Experience with UI/UX design, particularly the development of web-based or desktop interfaces for scientific data visualization
- Experience with virtualization tools, e.g., Docker, Apptainer

The ability to work independently is a prerequisite, as is the ability to interact effectively with the center's research and technical staff and external research groups in a team-oriented manner Advanced knowledge of English is essential, as this is the working language of the center.

•    Experience working with athletes who have achieved success at national or international level.

•    Experience mentoring elite coaches.

•    International coaching experience across Europe.

International Competition & Travel Requirements:

The successful candidate must be willing and able to work in Switzerland while maintaining a highly flexible international travel schedule.
The role requires frequent travel throughout Europe and, when necessary, internationally to accompany athletes during competitions, training camps, technical seminars and other high-performance events.
Availability to travel on weekends, public holidays and during school holiday periods is essential, as athletes regularly compete and participate in training camps outside standard working days.
The successful candidate will be expected to provide on-site technical coaching throughout the entire duration of competitions and training camps, including official practice sessions, warm-ups, competition preparation, rink-side coaching during performances, post-performance technical analysis and athlete supervision.
Candidates should also demonstrate proven experience accompanying athletes to national and international competitions while coordinating effectively with event organisers, technical officials, coaching teams and athletes' families.

•    Commitment to continuous professional development.
•    Strong organisational and planning capabilities.
•    Collaborative mindset within multidisciplinary coaching environments.

What We Offer:

•    Permanent employment within an ambitious Swiss high-performance figure skating organisation.
•    Opportunity to shape the long-term technical direction of a growing international programme.
•    International coaching environment.
•    Professional autonomy.
•    Competitive salary package commensurate with qualifications and experience.
•    Continuous professional development opportunities.
•    Opportunity to contribute to the development of athletes competing nationally and internationally.

Applicants should submit:

title: Human Factors Engineer
description:
Human Factors Engineer
----------------------

Roche Schweiz bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our longstanding client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a

**Human Factors Engineer**
==========================

**Background:**

Roche Diagnostics Global Customer Experience and Solution Design Team (CXSD team) is looking for a passionate Senior Human Factors Engineer to redefine Roche User Interface and Product design and transform the Healthcare industry for the better. At CXSD you will join an international group of designers that serve our purpose to bring the voice of customers to the core of Roche Diagnostics decisions by designing and enabling a seamless patient-centric experience across our portfolio of products and services. You'll be part of building design maturity for Roche with peers who are passionate, energetic, and caring in a connected, multicultural, highly motivated team.

As a Human Factors Engineer, you will play a key role in the development of the next generation of medical devices that can diagnose critical diseases. You will be responsible for leading and documenting studies aimed at providing insights for the development team to improve the design as well as to provide objective evidence that the design outputs of a certain phase in the product development life-cycle are meeting all requirements.

**The Perfect Candidate** has more than 5 years of experience in applied Human Factor Engineering and in Design Control Management. Additionally, the person is experienced in the Usability Engineering process for medical devices made of both hardware and software, as well as in planning, executing, and documenting usability studies in the medical field. Also, the person is knowledgeable of the IEC 62366 standard and the latest FDA guidance on applying human factors engineering. Lastly, the candidate communicates fluently in English.

**Tasks \& Responsibilities:**

* Be the voice of patients and Roche users in every product-related discussion
* Identify user profiles, tasks, hazard-related use scenarios, usability risks, and requirements
* Responsible for translating UX research insights, user needs, business requirements, and technical requirements into pleasant and efficient User Experiences
* Responsible for creating medical device usability deliverables according to IEC 62366
* Create and facilitate workshops with the product teams to gather system-level information and to coordinate the design deliverables
* Plan formative and summative usability studies and coordinate external suppliers in the process
* Prepare, maintain, and review Usability Engineering Files
* Advocate for accessibility, quality, and usability for end-users at Roche Diagnostics
* Provide guidance and mentorship to more junior designers supporting them on professional development, output, and productivity

**Must Haves:**

* Master's degree in Science, Industrial Engineering, Human Factors Engineering, or other related technical field
* Min. 5 years experience in applied Human Factor Engineering and in Design Control Management
* Experience in the Usability Engineering process for medical devices made of both hardware and software
* Experienced in planning, executing, and documenting usability studies in the medical field
* Experience collecting and analyzing physiological and behavioral data
* Experience in creating, facilitating, and analyzing workshops with customers and stakeholders
* Excellent presentation skills and ability to communicate know-how, experiences, ideas, solutions, and deliverables effectively and persuasively
* Knowledge of the IEC 62366 standard and the latest FDA guidance on applying human factors engineering
* Fluency in English. Other languages are always a big plus

**What is offered:**

* A chance to contribute to one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies
* Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting zones
* Central location with motorway connection and train station nearby
* Varied work profile
* Home office possibility
* Training opportunities through temptraining
* Collaboration in a dynamic and motivated team
* Good remuneration

You are welcome to send your complete application documents to Mr. Severin Räfle.

description:

The Portfolio Manager will support a Senior Portfolio Manager in the systematic trading of interest rate derivatives, cross\-currency products, and long\-dated currency derivatives across developed and emerging markets, generating high\-quality risk\-adjusted returns through the effective deployment of allocated Firm capital.  
What You’ll Do  
Formulate and implement relative value investment strategies across global fixed income and macro markets.

Minimum of 2–3 years of portfolio management experience managing a macro / interest rate / FX relative value investment strategy within an institutional trading environment.  
Experience operating successfully in a high\-performance trading environment and working collaboratively within a team of investment professionals.

Strong expertise in trading and portfolio management of linear and non\-linear rates products, including interest rate swaps, options, cross\-currency derivatives, and sovereign fixed income instruments.

title: Account Manager
description:
As an Account Manager (100%) in Zurich, you become the trusted host for a portfolio of clients: the person who makes sure their FELFEL experience keeps getting better, from their very first weeks with us all the way to renewal. You'll build real relationships, spot what each client needs before they ask, and turn happy customers into long\-term partners.  
Account Manager  
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES  
Own and manage a large portfolio of clients from post trial engagement to renewal.  
Build and maintain strong, long\-term relationships with key contacts to manage expectations and overall satisfaction and retention.  
Analyze client needs continuously to optimize their experience and pinpoint cross\-sell or upsell opportunities.  
Drive organic growth actively within your segment to maximize account potential and business value.  
Engage proactively with clients flagged during health checks and monitor key metrics to prevent churn proactively.  
Lead account reviews, contract negotiations, and renewals with confidence and care.  
Work hand in hand with our Acquisition, Product, Operations, and Support teams so every client gets one seamless FELFEL experience.  
Bring what you hear from clients back inside, so we keep making our food and service better.  
YOUR PROFILE  
3–5 years in account management, client success, or a similar customer\-facing role.  
Proven track record of efficiently managing and growing a large, diverse client portfolio.  
Confidence with CRM tools (Hubspot) to keep your work organized and your clients well looked after.  
A proactive, solution\-oriented mindset that combines a sales instinct with a real sense of hospitality — you spot opportunities to grow accounts while genuinely taking care of people.  
Excellent communication skills and the ease to connect with everyone from an office manager to a CEO.  
Energy for a fast\-paced environment, paired with the patience to build relationships that last.  
Fluent German and proficient in English.  
Non\-smoker \- we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.  
Valid work permit or Swiss passport.  
YOU WILL BE MEASURED BY  
Net Revenue Retention (NRR)  
Churn Rate  
Portfolio Growth (Cross\-sell/Upsell)  
Client Health Score  
Customer Satisfaction (CSAT or NPS)  
OUR BENEFITS  
Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk \- we make your gastronomic dreams come true  
Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine  
5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation  
Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day  
We care about your future with an above\-mandatory pension fund  
New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.  
We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half\-fare travelcard  
Great team events, such as our well\-known FELFEL Summer Outing  
Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions  
Ready to apply? If this sounds like the perfect role for you, please submit (German or English):  
Your CV \& complete documents (references, diplomas)  
A short video introducing yourself and telling us why you are our next Account Manager (. 1 minute)  
ABOUT US  
FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality.  
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first\-class, ultra\-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein \- our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).  
FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013\. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

title: Accounting Clerk/Secretary
description:
Accounting Clerk/Secretary  
We are an independent Swiss asset management firm based in Geneva, we specialize in financing the real economy through private credit solutions focused on sustainable agricultural and food value chains in emerging and frontier markets. As a prudentially regulated impact investor, we combine rigorous financial discipline with ESG and impact objectives in an international environment.  
Our human\-sized team offers an accountant / secretary the opportunity to work at the heart of operations: supporting bookkeeping and financial reporting, assisting with administrative and corporate documentation, and coordinating office and governance processes in close collaboration with senior management. You will evolve in a multilingual, multi\-cultural setting, interacting with banks, investors and service providers, while contributing to projects that have tangible economic and social relevance in the real economy.  
Accounting Clerk/Secretary  
Overall duties and responsabilities:  
Support day\-to\-day bookkeeping: supplier invoices, expense claims, payments, basic reconciliations and month\-end support.  
Prepare VAT return on a quaterly basis  
Support with auditors (finance / HR / taxes)Handle office administration and secretarial work: mail and call handling, document formatting, filing, and meeting.  
Assist with HR administration: maintaining employee files and HR documents, tracking absences/holidays.  
Liaise with banks, service providers and internal teams to gather information, clarify accounting/HR, questions and ensure smooth operations in a small, international office  
Notifies management of any anomaly, situation or particular problem and, as necessary, proposes changes or improvements to the work flow within the unit.  
Profile :  
Commercial apprenticeship or equivalent, with initial experience in accounting / administration in Switzerland.  
3 to 4 years minimum experience preferably in a professional accounting/audit firm, bank, asset manager or commodities good command of Excel and standard office tools; experience with accounting software is an asset.  
Very strong attention to detail, organisation and discretion; comfortable working in French and English in a multicultural environment.  
Must have the legal right to work in Switzerland (valid work/residence permit or Swiss/EU citizenship), and be able to work on site in Geneva on a regular basis.
